verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents event-driven triggers on incoming email, AI filters, and one-time scheduled send. None of these is a recurring, time-based job or workflow schedule. Scheduled send is a one-off delayed email, and triggers and filters fire on arrival rather than on a schedule, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit. The Tasklet and Zapier integrations are external tools, not Shortwave's own scheduling capability.
